008package createexperiment.app;
009
010import paint.shared.objects.ExperimentInfo;
011
012import java.io.File;
013import java.io.IOException;
014import java.nio.file.Files;
015import java.nio.file.Path;
016import java.util.ArrayList;
017import java.util.List;
018import java.util.regex.Matcher;
019import java.util.regex.Pattern;
020
021import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV;
022import static paint.shared.io.MainIOInterface.writeSpecificExperimentInfoFile;
023
024/**
025 * Provides functionality to generate and write an experiment information CSV file
026 * based on a list of ND2 recording files. Automatically parses and extracts condition
027 * and replicate numbers from filenames, and ensures unique file names to avoid overwriting.
028 */
029public class ExperimentInfoWriter {
030
031    /**
032     * Regular expression pattern for extracting metadata from filenames of experiment recordings.
033     * <p>
034     * Expected filename format:
035     * <pre>
036     * [digits]-Exp-[digits]-[uppercase letter][digits]-[digits].nd2
037     * </pre>
038     * Groups:
039     * <ul>
040     *   <li>Group 1 – Condition number</li>
041     *   <li>Group 2 – Replicate number</li>
042     * </ul>
043     */
044    private static final Pattern FILENAME_PATTERN =
045            Pattern.compile("^\\d+-Exp-(\\d+)-[A-Z]\\d+-(\\d+)\\.nd2$");
046
047    /**
048     * Writes experiment recording metadata into a CSV file located in the specified experiment directory.
049     * <p>
050     * Each ND2 recording file is parsed into an {@link ExperimentInfo} instance containing structured
051     * metadata such as condition and replicate numbers. The resulting table is serialized as
052     * {@code Experiment Info.csv}, with numeric suffixing to avoid overwriting existing files.
053     *
054     * @param experimentDirPath the directory where the experiment CSV will be created
055     * @param recordings        list of ND2 recording files to process
056     * @return the created {@code File} object pointing to the resulting CSV file
057     * @throws IOException if directory creation or file writing fails
058     */
059    public static Path exportExperimentInfo(Path experimentDirPath, List<File> recordings) throws IOException {
060        Files.createDirectories(experimentDirPath);
061
062        // Build ExperimentInfo objects from filenames
063        List<ExperimentInfo> infos = new ArrayList<>();
064
065        for (File rec : recordings) {
066            String name = rec.getName();
067            ExperimentInfo info = new ExperimentInfo();
068            info.setRecordingName(name);
069
070            // Try to parse condition and replicate from filename
071            Matcher m = FILENAME_PATTERN.matcher(name);
072            if (m.matches()) {
073                info.setConditionNumber(Integer.parseInt(m.group(1)));
074                info.setReplicateNumber(Integer.parseInt(m.group(2)));
075            } else {
076                info.setConditionNumber(0);
077                info.setReplicateNumber(0);
078            }
079
080            // Default values
081            info.setProcessFlag(true);
082            info.setProbeName("");
083            info.setProbeType("");
084            info.setCellType("");
085            info.setAdjuvant("");
086            info.setConcentration(0.0);
087            info.setThreshold(0.0);
088
089            infos.add(info);
090        }
091
092        // --- Write table
093        Path csvFilePath = uniqueFile(experimentDirPath, EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV);
094        writeSpecificExperimentInfoFile(csvFilePath, infos);
095
096        return csvFilePath;
097
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * Ensures the output filename is unique by appending an incremented suffix if needed.
102     *
103     * @param dirPath      directory for the file
104     * @param fileName desired file name
105     * @return a unique path reference that does not overwrite existing files
106     */
107    @SuppressWarnings("SameParameterValue")
108    private static Path uniqueFile(Path dirPath, String fileName) {
109        int    dot  = fileName.lastIndexOf('.');
110        String stem = (dot >= 0) ? fileName.substring(0, dot) : fileName;
111        String ext  = (dot >= 0) ? fileName.substring(dot) : "";
112
113        Path candidate = dirPath.resolve(fileName);
114        int n = 1;
115
116        while (Files.exists(candidate)) {
117            candidate = dirPath.resolve(stem + "-" + n + ext);
118            n++;
119        }
120
121        return candidate;
122    }
123}
